clue.text: They'll accommodate you if you put in estimates

indicators.note: the word for you is placed inside the word for estimates

parts.note: estimates are rough guesses
thou is the old form of you

explanation.surface: Lodgings will take you in if you supply some rough figures.
explanation.walkthrough: Thou is the archaic singular 'you', a common crossword convention; 'if' is only a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Lodging houses for paying guests offer rooms, so they house visitors.

clue.text: Uruguay can put up a number of soldiers

parts.note: U is the international vehicle code for Uruguay

indicators.note: in a down clue, putting a word up means reading it from the bottom upwards

parts.note: a can is a tin

explanation.surface: A South American country is able to raise a body of troops.
explanation.walkthrough: International vehicle codes, like U for Uruguay, are standard crossword abbreviations.
explanation.definitionFit: A military unit is a body of soldiers organised together.

clue.text: Killed — and swing for it!

explanation.surface: A murderer faces the gallows.
explanation.definitionFit: Slew is the past tense of slay, and to slew is also to turn or swivel round.

clue.text: The acre is different when measuring area metrically

indicators.note: the letters of the phrase are made different by rearranging them

explanation.surface: The acre gives way to another unit under the metric system.
explanation.definitionFit: A hectare, 10,000 square metres, is the metric unit of land measurement.

clue.text: Tree father planted in north America

indicators.note: one word is set into the other like a seedling in soil

parts.note: the US occupies much of North America
pa is an informal word for father

explanation.surface: Dad sets a sapling in the soil somewhere in the northern part of the Americas.
explanation.walkthrough: The upas is a poisonous tree of southeast Asia, once fabled to kill anything near it.
explanation.definitionFit: The upas is a toxic Asian tree of the fig family.

clue.text: For example, rising in the morning with enthusiasm

indicators.note: the reversed abbreviation goes inside the word for morning time

parts.note: early describes the first part of the day, the morning

indicators.note: in a down clue, rising reads the letters upwards

explanation.surface: Getting out of bed at dawn is a sign of keenness.
explanation.walkthrough: 'the morning' stands for the adjective early, as in an early start; 'rising' only works because this is a down entry.
explanation.definitionFit: Doing something keenly and willingly is acting with zeal.

clue.text: He was always ready to accept a sovereign

definitions.text: He was always ready to accept a sovereign

parts.words: He was always ready to accept a sovereign
parts.note: the turncoat cleric of an English folk song who switched faith with every new monarch so as to keep his living

explanation.surface: A man who would take a gold coin from anyone.
explanation.walkthrough: A sovereign is also a British gold coin, suggesting someone easily bribed; really it means a monarch, as in the 18th-century song.
explanation.definitionFit: The song's parson accepted each new king or queen's religion to stay in post.

clue.text: Charge rates, otherwise he will attend uninvited

indicators.note: the letters are arranged otherwise, in a different order

explanation.surface: Raise the entry fee or an unwanted guest will turn up.
explanation.definitionFit: An intruder is someone who comes to a party without being asked.

clue.text: She lives in Los Angeles

indicators.note: the word for lives goes into the city abbreviation

parts.note: lives, meaning exists, is the verb is

explanation.surface: A woman resides in a Californian city.
explanation.definitionFit: A girl's name, so it can stand for any woman referred to as she.

clue.text: The cost to be met in a bayonet attack?

explanation.surface: Wondering about the price of a bayonet charge.
explanation.definitionFit: A standing cost that does not vary, and literally a charge with bayonets fixed.

clue.text: Get on as a passenger

explanation.surface: Board a vehicle as a traveller.
explanation.definitionFit: To fare is to get along or manage, and a fare is a paying traveller in a taxi.

clue.text: Well-directed children

parts.note: the nursery-rhyme pair who went up the hill to fetch a pail of water, heading for a well

explanation.surface: Kids who have been properly guided.
explanation.definitionFit: The nursery-rhyme boy and girl climbed the hill towards a water source.

clue.text: Mother sails out in signs of settled weather

indicators.note: out signals the letters are put out of their order

explanation.surface: Mum goes sailing when the forecast looks calm.
explanation.definitionFit: Lines on a weather map joining places of equal temperature mark stable conditions.

clue.text: Harsh wind from south and east

parts.note: Auster is the Roman name for the south wind
E is the compass abbreviation for east

explanation.surface: A cold, biting gale blowing from two directions.
explanation.definitionFit: Severe and stern, without comfort or softness.

clue.text: Concluded that many are in dire need

indicators.note: the letter for many is placed inside the scrambled word
dire, meaning dreadful, signals the word need is put into a bad state

parts.note: D is the Roman numeral for 500, a large number

explanation.surface: It is decided that lots of people are badly off.
explanation.walkthrough: 'dire' rearranges NEED as ENED, and 'are in' places D inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: Finished or brought to a close.

clue.text: Allure of heartless girl having love affair

indicators.note: removing the heart of the word girl keeps only its first and last letters

parts.note: amour is a love affair, often a secret one

explanation.surface: The charm of a cold-hearted young woman embarking on a romance.
explanation.definitionFit: Glamour is attractive charm, the same as allure as a noun.

clue.text: Pop's executors?

parts.note: suggests those carrying out a father's will, but means a band that performs pop music

explanation.surface: Who handles Dad's estate?
explanation.definitionFit: A band of musicians performs, or executes, pop songs.

clue.text: A record that's not way out?

explanation.surface: A disc that is not avant-garde.
explanation.definitionFit: An entry is an item written in a register, and also a way in rather than an exit.

clue.text: A bird box may describe it

definitions.text: A bird box may describe it

parts.words: A bird box may describe it
parts.note: a nesting box for birds is suggested, but the word box can precede the name of a raptor to give a kind of flying toy

explanation.surface: A nesting box might be labelled with the species it holds.
explanation.definitionFit: The bird of prey shares its name with a flying toy, one type being a box design.

clue.text: Periods of maritime decline

parts.note: sounds like eras when navies faded, but means times when the sea goes out

explanation.surface: Eras when a seafaring power waned.
explanation.definitionFit: Outgoing tides are the sea level falling, a nautical receding.

clue.text: An awkward brute to disprove

indicators.note: an awkward arrangement of the word brute shuffles its letters

explanation.surface: A clumsy thug must be proved wrong.
explanation.definitionFit: To refute an argument is to show it false.

clue.text: Bones for stays

explanation.surface: A skeleton is what is left behind.
explanation.definitionFit: Mortal remains are a corpse or skeleton, and remains also means stays put.

clue.text: Well content in Wonderland

parts.note: in the Dormouse's tale at the Mad Tea-Party, three sisters live at the bottom of a well filled with syrup

explanation.surface: Feeling quite happy in a fairy-tale land.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Well content' reads as 'very happy'; really it is what fills the well in Lewis Carroll's Alice in Wonderland. Treacle is British for dark syrup.
explanation.definitionFit: Carroll's Dormouse tells of a well full of golden syrup.

clue.text: Outside left required to be prodded into action

indicators.note: the word for required goes outside the letter for left

parts.note: required means needed

explanation.surface: A winger was needed to be spurred on.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Outside left' looks like a football position; 'Outside' puts NEEDED round L.
explanation.definitionFit: To goad or provoke someone is to spur them on.

clue.text: Undisclosed military rank

explanation.surface: A secret army grade.
explanation.definitionFit: Kept secret, and also the lowest grade of soldier.

clue.text: The press is said to be in the doorway

indicators.note: the word is heard spoken, giving the same sound

parts.note: a crush or press of people is a jam

explanation.surface: Reporters are reported to be lurking at the door.
explanation.walkthrough: 'The press' suggests journalists, but means a crowded crush, a JAM.
explanation.definitionFit: A doorpost, the upright side piece of a door frame.

clue.text: Notion not quite perfect

indicators.note: the word is not quite complete, losing its final letter

parts.note: perfect means ideal

explanation.surface: An imperfect thought.
explanation.definitionFit: A concept or thought.

clue.text: Guns raised when hunted animal seen

indicators.note: in a down clue, raised turns the word upwards

parts.note: gats is slang for pistols

explanation.surface: Weapons go up when the quarry appears.
explanation.definitionFit: A male deer, the classic quarry of the chase.

clue.text: Blue feathers?

explanation.surface: Sad about some plumage.
explanation.definitionFit: Down means depressed, and also soft fine plumage.

clue.text: Justification for v-sign

parts.note: a sign is an indication

explanation.surface: Defending a rude gesture.
explanation.walkthrough: A v-sign is a rude British hand gesture; here it is literally a V followed by a sign.
explanation.definitionFit: Being proved right, or the defence of a claim.

clue.text: Three students seen around university in break

indicators.note: the three letters sit around the letter for university

parts.note: L for learner, as on a British learner driver's plate, three times

explanation.surface: A trio of learners hang about the campus during a pause.
explanation.definitionFit: A quiet pause or respite.

clue.text: Eastern country spy selling land not his own

parts.note: a state is a nation
a secret agent is a spy

explanation.surface: An oriental spy is flogging territory that does not belong to him.
explanation.definitionFit: A property broker sells houses on behalf of their owners.
